state_writes: canonical battlefield entry and attachment relation
targets: exactly one battlefield creature for the Bestow alternative
hidden_information: hand identity remains owner-private until the public cast
projection omits internal annotations and physical IDs
layers: bestowed attached card is an Enchantment Aura rather than a creature
unattached card resumes its ordinary copied characteristics
copy: unrepresented copied or text-changed Bestow descriptors fail closed
control_change: attachment legality and modifiers use current controller-independent relations
zone_change: target loss before resolution produces ordinary creature resolution
attachment loss leaves the bestowed permanent on the battlefield as a creature
source_leaves: the Bestow descriptor belongs to the physical card and current complete CardProgram

variants: fixed mono- and multicolored ordinary mana costs

partial cards whose attached result remains material
copied, granted, text-changed, or multiple Bestow instances
cast permissions and prohibitions that distinguish creature from Aura spells
multiface cards, spell copies, and tokens
